places: river mouth , Angola, Namibia, Botswana, and Zimbabwe

fields.terrain: mostly coastal lowlands, uplands in center, high plateaus in northwest, mountains in west
fields.hazards: severe droughts; devastating cyclones and floods in central and southern provinces
fields.resources: coal, titanium, natural gas, hydropower, tantalum, graphite
fields.farm: cassava, maize, sugarcane, tomatoes, beans, potatoes, sweet potatoes, bananas, coconuts, onions
fields.exports: coal, natural gas, aluminum, gold, precious stones
fields.industries: aluminum, petroleum products, chemicals (fertilizer, soap, paints), textiles, cement, glass, asbestos, tobacco, food, beverages
fields.languages: Makhuwa 26.1%, Portuguese (official) 16.6%, Tsonga 8.6%, Nyanja 8.1, Sena 7.1%, Lomwe 7.1%, Chuwabo 4.7%, Ndau 3.8%, Tswa 3.8%, other Mozambican languages 11.8%, other 0.5%, unspecified 1.8%
fields.religions: Catholic 27.3%, Islam 19.1%, Pentecostal 16.7%, Saio/Zione 16.3%, no religion 13.5%, other 4.3%, Anglican 1.7%, unknown 1.2%
fields.legal: mixed system of Portuguese civil law and customary law
fields.military: registration for military service is mandatory for all men and women at 18 years of age; 18-35 years of age for selective compulsory military service…
